title: ITSP.10.171 maintenance personnel authorization and supervision need operating records
remediation: The sponsor maintenance access owner approves personnel and contractor organizations, keeps the authorized list current, and validates access for unescorted personnel. Sample an authorized visit and a supervised visit with the assigned supervisor’s required authorization and documented technical competence. The sponsor confirms the assessed ITSP.10.171 supplementary boundary and accountable owner.

milestones.title: Collect the approved personnel and provider roster, an unescorted access decision and a supervised maintenance sample
